subject: Consultant Lab Cohort — mentorship & practicum proposal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Foley <kate@bluewillow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consultant Lab Cohort — mentorship & practicum proposal

Hi Kate,

Great meeting earlier — thanks for walking through BlueWillow's consulting intake. As discussed, I've attached a short proposal that outlines a 6-week "Partner Lab" pilot: a curated cohort where BlueWillow consultants shadow Redwood SEs, lead two hands-on practicum sessions with a sandbox dataset, and co-deliver a final "migration readiness" assessment for a nominated customer.

High-level asks from our side:
- 6 consultant seats (2 lead mentors + 4 participants)
- One dedicated SE to support the cohort (we can rotate)
- Agreed evaluation rubric (technical delivery, prompt engineering, inference config)

Attachments: redwood-partner-lab-proposal.pdf (proposal + timeline)
Drive outline: https://drive.google.com/redwood/partner-lab-outline

If this looks good I can circulate a draft SOW and propose 3 start dates (early Sep / mid Sep / late Sep).

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

From: Kate Foley <kate@bluewillow.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Jensen <mark@brightlane.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultant Lab Cohort — mentorship & practicum proposal

Connor — thanks, this is timely. BlueWillow is definitely interested in a pilot. A couple of quick clarifications:

1) Brightlane (one of our early adopter customers) wants to join the practicum as the "playground" customer — will that be OK?
2) We prefer a 4-week intensive with an additional two-week shadow/observation period rather than a stretched 6-week timeline.

I've attached our standard SOW template so we can start lining up commercial terms. I'm copying Mark (Brightlane) so he has visibility.

Attachments: SOW-template.docx

Would be great to lock a start week so we can commit consultants.

— Kate
Kate Foley
Head of Partnerships | BlueWillow Consulting
kate@bluewillow.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultant Lab Cohort — mentorship & practicum proposal

Connor / team — moving this internal so we can scope delivery. Thoughts / asks below:

- Convert to 4+2 format (4-week bootcamp + 2 weeks observation) — fine by us, reduces SE commitment.
- We should create a mentor rotation schedule (SEs + PM) and a compact evaluation rubric. I sketched metrics: lab completion, inference latency tuning exercise, prompt-robustness score, customer handoff readiness.
- Budget: ask partnerships to propose a blended rate and whether BlueWillow will share customer fees for the practicum (Brightlane).
- Legal: Kate mentioned SOW — loop in procurement for NDAs / Data processing addendum since Brightlane will provide a sandbox extract.

Connor — can you draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and add a suggested mentor-pool? I'll take point on evaluation rubric. Marissa, can you confirm training materials availability for week 1 hands-on labs?

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Field Alliances | Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Foley <kate@bluewillow.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultant Lab Cohort — mentorship & practicum proposal

Ack — thanks, Laura. Draft MAP attached inline and I've proposed a mentor-pool (attached spreadsheet). Key items I'm proposing to include in the MAP:

- Kickoff week (week 0): joint orientation + sandbox provisioning
- Week 1: prompt engineering & token-cost optimization lab (hands-on)
- Week 2: inference configuration & quantization demo; cost-performance tradeoffs
- Week 3: customer-focused practicum with Brightlane sample flows

Proposed start windows: Sep 8, Sep 15, Sep 29.
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (BlueWillow record)
Jira ticket created: JIRA-OPS-1123 (partner-lab pilot scope)

Attachments: mentor-pool-catalog.xlsx

I'll draft the SOW based on BlueWillow's template and push for a signed SOW + DPA before sandbox access. Connor

From: Kate Foley <kate@bluewillow.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Jensen <mark@brightlane.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultant Lab Cohort — mentorship & practicum proposal

Connor — thanks for the clear MAP and dates. Mark and I reviewed the windows and Sep 15 start works best for Brightlane's calendar. Two small items before we confirm:

1) NDAs/DPA — can Redwood legal send a short DPA addendum tied to the sandbox extract? We can countersign next week.
2) Billing — BlueWillow will be happy to cover a portion of the mentor stipend; please include an estimated statement of work line items so we can align on cost split.

Forwarding our SOW note here for convenience.

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Mark Jensen <mark@brightlane.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultant Lab Cohort — practicum sandbox details
To: Kate Foley <kate@bluewillow.com>

Kate — excited to participate. We can provide a redacted dataset and a test API key for week 2. Legal will expect a DPA and a short SLA for the sandbox uptime during the pilot.

Thanks — Mark
notes: Internal action: Connor to upload draft SOW to Drive and ping procurement for DPA (due 2025-08-25).
Set Jira: JIRA-OPS-1123 to track mentor assignment and sandbox provisioning.
Target start date agreed: 2025-09-15 (subject to signed SOW + DPA).
